unlisted_practices: Retrospective real-world AI fundus screening with manual interpretation to validate AI predictions
Stratified analysis of AI detection rates by comorbidities and systemic risk factors
Building multi-institutional data platform for retinal disease management

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and clinical yield of an AI system for screening diabetic retinopathy and fundus abnormalities in a large clinical population, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
